title: Smart Shopper Math
topic: Fraction of a Quantity - Initial, Final, and Change
subject: Mathematics

questions.question: Mrs Tan used 2/5 of a bag of rice. After using, she had 9 kg of rice left. What was the mass of the full bag of rice?
questions.explanation: If she used 2 out of 5 units, then 3 units = 9 kg. So 1 unit = 9 kg ÷ 3 = 3 kg. Full bag = 5 units × 3 kg = 15 kg.

questions.question: Mr Lim bought a bag of flour. He used 3/4 of it and had 2 kg left. How many kilograms of flour did he use?
questions.explanation: If he used 3 out of 4 units, then 1 unit = 2 kg. Full bag = 4 units × 2 kg = 8 kg. He used = 8 kg - 2 kg = 6 kg.

questions.question: Siti had a bag of sugar. After using 3/8 of it, she had 10 kg left. How many kilograms of sugar did she use?
questions.explanation: If she used 3 out of 8 units, then 5 units = 10 kg. So 1 unit = 10 kg ÷ 5 = 2 kg. Full bag = 8 units × 2 kg = 16 kg. She used = 16 kg - 10 kg = 6 kg.

questions.question: A baker had a bag of flour. He used 2/3 of it to make bread. He then had 4 kg left. How many kilograms of flour were in the full bag?
questions.explanation: If he used 2 out of 3 units, then 1 unit = 4 kg. Full bag = 3 units × 4 kg = 12 kg.

questions.question: Mrs Wong used 5/8 of a bag of rice. She used 15 kg of rice. How many kilograms of rice were left?
questions.explanation: If she used 5 out of 8 units = 15 kg, then 1 unit = 15 kg ÷ 5 = 3 kg. Full bag = 8 units × 3 kg = 24 kg. Left = 24 kg - 15 kg = 9 kg.

questions.question: Mr Ravi bought a bag of onions. He sold 3/5 of it and had 8 kg left. How many kilograms of onions did he sell?
questions.explanation: If he sold 3 out of 5 units, then 2 units = 8 kg. So 1 unit = 8 kg ÷ 2 = 4 kg. He sold = 3 units × 4 kg = 12 kg.

questions.question: A shop had a bag of beans weighing 20 kg. After selling some, 2/5 of the bag remained. How many kilograms of beans were sold?
questions.explanation: Full bag = 5 units = 20 kg. So 1 unit = 20 kg ÷ 5 = 4 kg. Remaining = 2 units × 4 kg = 8 kg. Sold = 20 kg - 8 kg = 12 kg.

questions.question: Mrs Lim used 3/7 of a bag of potatoes. She used 6 kg of potatoes. How many kilograms of potatoes were in the full bag?
questions.explanation: If she used 3 out of 7 units = 6 kg, then 1 unit = 6 kg ÷ 3 = 2 kg. Full bag = 7 units × 2 kg = 14 kg.
